entries.title: A documented setting the storage layer never read
entries.summary: The env table documents `CODE_INDEX_PATH` as "Index storage location", and `config.py`, `process_registry.py`, `install_pack.py`, `receipt.py` and two `server.py` sites all read it. `IndexStore`, `SQLiteIndexStore` and `process_locks._lock_dir` hardcoded `Path.home() / ".code-index"` and ignored

entries.title: A config in the wrong shape is a client that reports success and registers nothing
entries.summary: `jcodemunch-mcp init` went from 5 auto-configured clients to 10: **Codex CLI**, **opencode**, **Gemini CLI**, **Cline** and **VS Code / GitHub Copilot** join Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf and Continue.

entries.title: Half the tool descriptions never said what the tool would not do
entries.summary: Scored every description this server emits against the rubric in [arXiv:2602.14878](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14878) (Hasan, Li, Rajbahadur, Adams & Hassan, Queen's University), which examined 856 tools across 103 MCP servers and found 97.1% carrying at least one description smell. Their rubric scores six
